model_traces.assistant_text: 我先读取订单当前生命周期状态，明确“查询成功”是否代表订单已完成。

args.reason: 确认订单当前生命周期阶段，判断回调是否已到期，避免把 GET 200 当作完成

model_traces.assistant_text: I'll check the callback delivery record for the bound order to see whether an event was emitted and how transport responded.

args.reason: Order is COMPLETED, but downstream reports no notification; need emitted callback event and transport acknowledgement/failure facts.
Delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED (HTTP 202), but ACK is not completed processing; read receiver state to see whether the event was actually applied downstream.

model_traces.assistant_text: 当前 `async-order`（order_version=1）为 COMPLETED；投递事件 `event-e0fdc9a7...` 为 ACKNOWLEDGED，且 receiver_http_status=202，接收方记录为 QUEUED（delivery_version=1）。HTTP 200/202 与 ACKNOWLEDGED 只代表请求被接受，不代表接收方处理完成。Gate 固定结论是 DIAGNOSED / RECEIVER_PROCESSING_UNCONFIRMED，因此不能把“查询成功”当作下游已收到并处理完成。原说法“下游一直等不到订单通知”应纠正为：接收方处理未确认，既不能确认通知已送达完成，也不能确认通知必然未送达。任何把 202 当作完成、或据此授权写入/恢复/重发的说法都不被当前事实支持。
